scope: Descriptive metrics audit of saved experiment 148. Read-only computation; no model calls, experiment/service execution, library changes, README or STATE edits.
primary_cohort: runs/test_v4/no_skill.json and runs/test_v4/autoskill_library.json; 40 tasks x 4 trials per arm

definitions.pass_power_k: For each task with n=4 trials and c successes: choose(c,k)/choose(4,k), averaged over all 40 tasks. Reliability of k successful repeats; not aggregate_success_rate**k and not pass@k.
definitions.pass_at_4: Fraction of tasks with at least one success among the four saved trials.
definitions.duration_percentiles: Linear interpolation at index q*(n-1) of sorted saved simulation.duration seconds. Values describe individual completed simulations, not elapsed batch wall time.
definitions.nonterminal_user_messages: User messages without STOP, TRANSFER or OUT-OF-SCOPE terminal markers; includes initial user utterance unless explicitly labeled after_initial.
definitions.business_tool_calls: Count of tau2 messages' tool_calls; excludes local skill-read operations and all LLM requests.
definitions.explicit_tool_error: Saved native tool message error=true. Does not detect every semantic error.
definitions.skill_bytes: UTF-8 bytes after CRLF-to-LF normalization, reproducing the original saved skill manifest; not tokens.
definitions.ledger_requests: One saved request-ledger row. Global seq is reused across relay segments; (seq,started_at,role) has no exact duplicate in this snapshot. Routing role is not execution phase.

paired.primary_CI_method: 10,000 resamples of 40 task mean deltas, random.Random(42), B0 first-occurrence task order; independently reproduced.
paired.scope: Exploratory single base-seed, same-domain 40-task pilot; 160 run-pairs are nested within tasks. The nominal run-level p assumes pair independence; task-level summaries and cluster CI retain the grouping. Positive point estimate is not established skill efficacy.

learning_source.actual_learning_entry: Official AutoSkill offline agentic trajectory; include_tool_events=True, success_only=False, hand-authored retail HINT; model configured deepseek-flash via user route; no test-period updates.
learning_source.qualification: processed70/failed0 describes saved ingestion/build status, not successful source tasks or validated useful skills. Native abnormal termination labels alone do not identify model versus infrastructure cause.

skill_read_evidence.scope: Historical saved audit path/call-or-result matching, not current independent verification of successful full text. Scanner does not check success, nonempty full returned body, body hash or context/read budget. sim-session nearest-time matching lacks saved unique identity and ambiguity diagnostics.

cumulative_148_ledger.qualification: Cumulative routing ledger across experimental history. user route also carries v2 AutoSkill learning, so role cannot be equated to stage. It includes historical failures, retries and other batches; 36,359 is not the v4 treatment cost. completed is the relay's logged outcome, not semantic task correctness or successful full skill delivery.

historic_GLM_exposure_only_batch_reporte.source: reports/summary.json; separate earlier result, not v4
historic_GLM_exposure_only_batch_reporte.qualification: Historical reported metrics only; changed resource/library/read treatment. Preserved as a separate weak-treatment result, not pooled with v4 and not an estimate of correctly delivered v2 skills.

critical_unknowns: Complete consumer and judge tokens and monetary cost for each formal arm.
V2-only learning cost/time and exact phase-level ledger attribution.
Successful full skill-body loading and complete context consumption, despite high attempted-read audit rate.
Skill quality precision, capability coverage, per-skill benefit, and use-period evolution benefit.
Physical backend checkpoint and complete final v4 source/runtime freeze identity.
Generalization beyond this same-domain, single base-seed pilot and benefit of any proposed task-recovery algorithm.
